StageAttention: A fusion born from the wills of the fallen "Vanguard" members, formed after countless worlds fell to ruin. Bearing the grief of their civilization's destruction, they wander the endless Fog for ages, their human rationality long lost. They cling to but one shared desire: the "Homecoming Voyage". They wish to return to their home, to return to the most beautiful past.

"Vanguard" charges and hurls lances that can be parried by the current character. Multiple successful parries will stun "Vanguard" for an extended period. Failure will cause additional lances to remain on the field.
"Vanguard" flicks up the lances remaining on the field and kicks them out, dealing damage to the area in front.
"Vanguard" summons an array of lances before rapidly dashing through it, dealing AOE DMG.
"Vanguard" levitates in midair, creating tracking fog projectiles underfoot before landing to deal massive AOE DMG. A Precise Dodge followed by a Counterattack will stagger "Vanguard".
"Vanguard" summons a portal and leaps into it, remaining hidden for a time before emerging to attack. A Precise Dodge followed by a Counterattack will stagger "Vanguard".
